name: Xterminate
review:
Xterminate is a 5x6 sci-fi slot with scatter-pay wins, the Xterminate multiplier and charged wilds.

Thunderkick rates it Very High volatility, with a 25,000x cap. The published RTP is 94.12%.

Scatter-pay wins count from anywhere on the 5x6 grid, and charged wilds plus the Xterminate multiplier drive the big hits. It's one of the studio's harder-edged recent games.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
